'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Colombian conflict]]
**A [[car bomb]] [[explode]]s near a [[police station]] in Timba, [[Cauca Department]], [[Colombia]], killing two people and wounding two others. [https://www.laprensalatina.com/at-least-two-dead-and-two-wounded-in-colombian-car-bomb-blast/amp/ (La Prensa Latina)]
*[[Nagorno-Karabakh conflict]]
**[[2023 Azerbaijani offensive in Nagorno-Karabakh]]
***The [[Artsakh Defence Army]] in [[Nagorno-Karabakh]] surrenders, accepting a [[Russia]]n-proposed [[ceasefire]] with [[Azerbaijan]] and agreeing to vacate combat positions, disarm, and relinquish all [[ammunition]] and [[military equipment]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-66863702 (BBC News)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/armenians-nagorno-karabakh-agree-disarm-2023-09-20/ (Reuters)] [https://apa.az/en/military/armenian-army-units-leave-the-territories-of-azerbaijan-illegal-armenian-armed-groups-dissloved-412271 (APA.az)]
***Peace talks between [[Azerbaijan]] and the separatists are expected to begin tomorrow in [[Yevlakh]]. [[Peacekeeping operations in Nagorno-Karabakh|Russia's peacekeeping contingent]] will assist in coordinating the ceasefire. [https://www.dw.com/en/nagorno-karabakh-azerbaijan-separatists-reach-cease-fire/live-66870362 (DW)]
***Thousands of [[Republic of Artsakh|Artsakh]] residents gather at the [[Stepanakert Airport]], where some Russian peacekeepers are stationed, seeking evacuation. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/thousands-of-armenians-in-karabakh-mass-at-airport-after-ceasefire-deal-1.6569557 (CTV News)]
***Several [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] [[Peacekeeping operations in Nagorno-Karabakh|peacekeepers]] are killed after Azeri forces open fire on their [[UAZ Patriot]] near [[Chankatagh]], [[Martakert Province]]. [[President of Azerbaijan]] [[Ilham Aliyev]] apologizes for the deaths and orders an investigation into the incident. [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2023/09/21/azerbaijans-aliyev-apologizes-for-russian-peacekeeper-deaths-in-karabakh-a82533 (''The Moscow Times'')] [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/world/soldiers-killed-in-attack-on-russian-peacekeeper-vehicle-in-karabakh-azerbaijan/2997394 (Anadolu Agency)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Three members of the [[South African Navy]] are killed and five others are rescued when large waves hit a [[submarine]] near [[Kommetjie]], [[Western Cape]], [[South Africa]]. [https://www.news24.com/news24/southafrica/news/two-naval-mariners-dead-2-hospitalised-after-rescue-operation-in-kommetjie-20230920 (News24)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Armenia–United States relations]]
**[[United States Armed Forces|United States]] and [[Armed Forces of Armenia|Armenian forces]] complete a joint [[military exercise]] in [[Armenia]], which was not affected by the [[2023 Azerbaijani offensive in Nagorno-Karabakh]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/9/20/us-completes-joint-military-exercise-in-armenia (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]], [[Poland–Ukraine relations]]
**Polish Prime Minister [[Mateusz Morawiecki]] announces that [[Poland]] will stop supplying [[Ukraine]] with weapons, amid tensions between the two countries over the former's import ban on Ukrainian agricultural products. [https://edition.cnn.com/2023/09/20/europe/poland-ukraine-weapons-grain-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)]
**Vasyl Zvarych, Ukrainian [[Ambassador]] to Poland, is summoned by the Polish Foreign Ministry to convey its strong protest over the statement of [[President of Ukraine|President]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]] at the United Nations General Assembly. Zelenskyy's statement that some European countries' actions indirectly help [[Russia]], drew condemnation from Poland. [https://ukranews.com/en/news/956790-ambassador-of-ukraine-urgently-summoned-to-polish-foreign-ministry-over-zelenskyy-s-statement-media (Ukrainian News)]
*Sixty-seven [[Member states of the United Nations|United Nations member states]] sign the [[High Seas Treaty]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20230920-high-seas-treaty-moves-closer-to-reality-with-first-signatures (AFP via France 24)]

'''Science and technology'''
*The oldest known wooden structure, a 476,000-year-old log structure, is discovered at the [[Kalambo Falls]] in [[Zambia]] according to a study from the [[Nature (journal)|''Nature'' journal]]. [https://www.livescience.com/archaeology/archaeologists-in-zambia-discover-oldest-wooden-structure-in-the-world-dating-to-476000-years-ago (Live Science)]
